title: Chest Mimic Lootr
description: Changes the texture of the Mimic to be like the Lootr chests
body:
[![alt text](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/aa8962f9-e6ff-4a83-8eeb-d145d3c55343.webp) ](https://bisecthosting.com/Zoni25)

This is a simple resource pack that changes the textures of the [Chest Mimic](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mimics-mod) mod to be more like the [Lootr](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/lootr) chests.

Also smooths the tongue and tongue sword textures.

 

If you want to get updates on the pack development, report bugs or suggest new stuff or just contact me join my discord server:
https://discord.com/invite/KWGakdBVwG
